name: Necromancer Crypt Swarm applies Crypt Plague for the Death specialization (#4540)
contract: Crypt Plague (92121) is the identity passive of Death (specialization 34, CharacterAdvancement entry 4034, AECost 0 and TECost 0), so selecting Death grants it like any other free tree node. Its own effects make Crypt Swarm (800343) apply the Crypt Plague disease 570131 to the target and the owner buff 573131 to the caster. knight-spec-tree-free-nodes.json covers the granting of free nodes itself; this scenario covers what the Necromancer's identity passive does once it is known.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Death grants its identity Crypt Plague
Crypt Plague granted its owner buff
